doctrine: System-driven business operator framework rooted in existing assets + network leverage. Core: Build from proof (25-30 free shoot submissions that convert), not from zero ideas. Two-lane model: Lane 1 = free/low-cost community work (casting calls, studio experiences, charity shoots) to build ecosystem + demand. Lane 2 = monetized services ($275-$550 hourly rates + project retainers). Pricing rule: free operates as top-of-funnel acquisition, not discount strategy. Monetize through: curated output control, experience design (Equinox vs LA Fitness positioning), repeatable systems, and conversion paths (free leads to paid repeat work). AI-proof moat is not tools but: access (camera + studio + LA scene proximity), taste, being good energy in rooms, and network (models with 30K-50K followers, makeup artists at Kardashian level, dancers, entertainment creatives, HBCU/Kappa connections). Three businesses identified: (1) Sniped Media = high-ticket ($1,500+) founder portraiture + creative direction, low-volume, taste-driven. (2) Baseplate = D2C product content engine (spec work method: shoot physical product once, use AI to generate infinite variations). (3) Platform play = aggregator/connector role (bring artists to brands, brands to talent, solve creative problems). Revenue path: move from monthly cash flow ($275-$550 shoots) to retainers ($1,500+) by specializing and deepening relationships. 30-day action: (1) run one monthly studio experience/casting call, (2) make 3-5 outreach calls to existing network weekly, (3) curate past shoot galleries (don't send everything), (4) convert 1-2 free shoots to paid follow-ups. Avoid: new ventures before proving current ones, overthinking AI, treating each shoot as one-off, undervaluing rates, generic 'build a brand' tactics. Operate: out of existing trust, network density over breadth, systems over novelty, iteration from proof not brainstorm.
